contacts.institution_name: Academy of Performing Arts in Prague

country.evidence_quote: The Academy of Performing Arts in Prague (AMU) is the largest and most prestigious arts university in the Czech Republic. Since its founding in 1945, it has been shaping new generations of creators and artists in the fields of film, theater, music, dance, and multimedia. Take a look at a selection of student work and get to know the creative environment at AMU.
